purpose: Teach: 前掲/ケ月/バラエティー/実費/従前/学士/専従/枠内

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の前掲セクションを参照しろ
lines.en: Ren — look at the cited section of the paper.
lines.style: Measured, directing. Slight pause before the instruction—not harsh, but expecting clarity of understanding. The voice of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験は三ケ月をかけて行います
lines.en: Yes. The experiment will take three months.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. No over-formality. A quick yes, then the information delivered with quiet competence. Small straightening of posture in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究テーマにバラエティーを持たせろ
lines.en: Ren — bring more variety into your research focus.
lines.style: Direct, clear-eyed. Not unkind, but unambiguous. The tone of someone refining work they see potential in. Brief pressure on the key word.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。フィールドワークの実費を申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll apply for fieldwork expenses.
lines.style: Taking the note seriously. Steady, responsive. The voice of someone turning instruction into action immediately. No hedging.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、従前の研究結果との比較をしろ
lines.en: Ren — compare your findings against previous research.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. The weight of experience in the phrasing. Expecting him to push the work deeper. A beat of emphasis on the comparison.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学士課程の学生にも指導します
lines.en: Yes. I'll mentor the undergraduates too.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. He's already thinking ahead. The words come steadily, a bit quick—showing he's already integrating the feedback. Small lift on the last phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、専従の研究補助を頼め
lines.en: Ren — bring in a dedicated research assistant.
lines.style: Quiet weight. Not a suggestion. The tone of someone closing a conversation with a final piece of guidance. Settled and expectant.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。倫理委員会の枠内で研究を進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep everything within the ethics committee framework.
lines.style: Closing statement. Respectful but finished. The voice of someone who has understood and accepted the full scope. A small exhale of assurance at the end.
